name: Jade Davis
source:
Jade is Platina's staff officer. He has a more serious and intelligent demeanor, with a quick tongue that may offend people, but he doesn't care. He is Platina's care-taker, and is very devoted to him. Since he is trying to help Platina win the battle of succession, he takes on a rather rival-like relationship with Sapphirus, Alex's staff officer. However, there seems to be a mysterious side of Jade that is hiding something...

[From [url=http://blgames.ukepile.com/database/apo/apoa.php]Boys' Love Games Headquarters[/url]]
